arguments.sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS avg_amount_usd FROM transactions
arguments.explanation: Returns the mean transaction amount in dollars across every row in the transactions table.
assumptions: Covers all 1,159,966 transactions, labelled or not, from 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
Negative amounts (56,900 rows, meaning undocumented) are included as recorded, not removed or treated as refunds.
Amounts are stored in US cents and divided by 100.0 to give dollars.
